meta.agent: D1 - Ingénierie / Définition des Paramètres Techniques
meta.status: initial specifications — to be refined by D2/D3/E2/E3
meta.note: All parameters are engineering targets. Final values require CFD (D2) and structural/avionics validation.

system_overview.role: Short-to-Medium Range Air Defense (SHORAD/M-SHORAD) interceptor — anti-drone, anti-swarm, anti-cruise missile

airframe.configuration: Missile with cruciform delta wings + rear cruciform tail fins

fuselage.material: Al-7075 T6 or carbon-fiber composite (depending on production volume)

wings.material: fiberglass or carbon-fiber composite over foam core

mass_budget.note: Mass budget drives propulsion selection. Total MTOW ≤ 2.5 kg to meet 1-12 km range with solid rocket motor.

nozzle.thrust_vectoring: None (V2: pneumatic grid-fin or jet vane)

propulsion.manufacturing: Cast-cured HTPB; steel motor case drawn or deep-drawn; phenolic nozzle moulded — compatible with 500+ units/year production

guidance_and_seeker.primary_mode: Semi-active radar (SAR) with radio-frequency datalink for mid-course guidance

mid_course.method: SAR illuminated by launch platform radar + uplink datalink

sensor_suite.secondary: electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) for terminal against low-RCS targets

targeting_interoperability.fire_control_compatibility: Rheinmetall Skynex, Diehl Iris-T, Rafael Drone Dome

warhead.note: Fragmentation tuned for air-target defeat (spall, structural failure). Lethal radius adequate for drone-class targets at miss distances up to 5 m.

kinematics.note: Missile designed to close the gap at > 500 m/s relative velocity with subsonic targets at 12 km.

primary.configuration: 4x8-tube or 6x6-tube canister array on 4x4 or 6x6 tactical vehicle

secondary.configuration: vertical launch system (VLS) or deck-mounted canister launcher

tertiary.configuration: fixed silo or bunker launcher, 4-12 tubes

propulsion_electric.note: Electric propulsion system + Battery + Motor Mount

guidance_seeker.note: Active MMW radar seeker + MEMS IMU + RF datalink

electronics_avionics.note: flight computer, actuator drivers, power conditioning

airframe_structure.note: Al-7075 CNC machined + wing/fins CF composite

qualification_certs.note: NATO STANAG certification, safety testing, QMS

unit_cost_breakdown.cost_note: Unit cost target is achievable at 500+ units/year production volume. At 1000+ units/year, cost could drop to $20-22k via learning curve. Non-recurring engineering (NRE) estimated separately at $15-25M.

manufacturing_approach: Al-7075-T6 fuselage CNC-machined from bar stock (low tooling cost, quick iteration)
Wing/fins: fiberglass or CFRP over machined foam mould — scalable composite layup
Electric motor SC-02, 3S LiPo battery, DMLS AlSi10Mg mount
Warhead: machined steel body + press-loaded explosive pellets
Avionics: COTS PCB assemblies (radar, IMU, MCU) — consumer/military grade mix
supply_chain_notes: Propellant chemicals (HTPB, AP, Al): civilian suppliers, ITAR-free (dual-use)
Electronics: NATO source (non-US preferred to reduce ITAR/EAR restrictions)
Tungsten: strategic material — consider recycled or alternative fragments
Steel motor case: European or Indian forging shop — avoids US ITAR
Guidance seeker:Ka-band radar — requires domestic fab or allied supplier (Israel, EU)
manufacturing_and_scalability.industrial_friendly_note: Design avoids US ITAR-critical components where possible to maximize NATO non-US and export market access.
regulatory_compliance: UN 1.4C / US DoD 1.3B classification for transport

d2_dependencies.scope: Validate aerodynamic coefficients (Cx, Cl, Cl/Cd), stability derivatives, and wing/fin geometry optimization via simplified CFD.
d2_dependencies.expected_output: Cf (friction), Cd0 (zero-lift drag), Cl_alpha, Cma, Cnp — 3 candidate configurations

d3_dependencies.scope: Validate structure design, select structural materials, define loads, and produce mechanical blueprint.
d3_dependencies.expected_output: Material selection, wall thickness, joint detail, fastener schedule

e2_dependencies.scope: Define electronics and seeker subsystem specifications (radar, datalink, flight computer).
e2_dependencies.expected_output: Schematic, PCB stack-up, component selection, power budget

e3_dependencies.scope: System-level integration: launch sequence, C2 interface, vehicle integration, TRL roadmap.
e3_dependencies.expected_output: System architecture diagram, integration ICD, TRL plan
